## Helper to assign correct class

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| label: siteswap-fn
#| code-line-numbers: "1-12|2-3|4-6"
siteswap <- function(sequence) {
  if (is_vanilla_notation(sequence)) {
    vanillaSiteswap(sequence)
  } else if (is_sync_notation(sequence)) {
    synchronousSiteswap(sequence)
  } else {
    cli::cli_abort(
      "Not valid vanilla or synchronous siteswap notation."
    )
  }
}
```

## `Siteswap` class constructor

```{r}
library(S7)
Siteswap <- new_class(
  "Siteswap",
  properties = list(
    sequence = class_character
  )
)
```


:::{.notes}
Building simplified versions of `Siteswap` and `vanillaSiteswap` class in these slides.

The versions in jugglr have more properties and more complex methods.
:::

## `Siteswap` with property validator

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 4-11
Siteswap <- new_class(
  "Siteswap",
  properties = list(
    sequence = new_property(
      class = class_character,
      validator = function(value) {
        if (length(value) != 1) {
          "must be length 1"
        }
      }
    )
  )
)
```

## `vanillaSiteswap` with computed properties and class validator

```{r}
#| echo: false
chr_throws_to_num <- function(throws) {
  match(tolower(throws), c(0:9, letters)) - 1
}

get_throws <- function(sequence) {
  throws_chr <- strsplit(sequence, "") |>
    unlist()

  chr_throws_to_num(throws_chr)
}

can_throw <- function(throws) {
  n <- length(throws)
  lands <- ((seq_len(n) - 1) + throws) %% n
  anyDuplicated(lands) == 0
}

is_whole_number <- function(x) {
  x %% 1 == 0
}

is_vanilla_notation <- function(sequence) {
  stringr::str_detect(sequence, "^[a-zA-Z0-9]+$")
}
```

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 1,3|4-10|11-16|17-22|23-28
vanillaSiteswap <- new_class(
  "vanillaSiteswap",
  parent = Siteswap,
  properties = list(
    throws = new_property(
      class = class_integer,
      getter = function(self) {
        get_throws(self@sequence) # e.g. "423" -> c(4, 2, 3)
      }
    ),
    n_props = new_property(
      class = class_numeric,
      getter = function(self) {
        mean(self@throws)
      }
    ),
    valid = new_property(
      class = class_logical,
      getter = function(self) {
        can_throw(self@throws) && is_whole_number(self@n_props)
      }
    )
  ),
  validator = function(self) {
    if (!is_vanilla_notation(self@sequence)) {
      "@sequence must only contain digits and letters."
    }
  }
)
```

:::{.notes}
Don't define a sequence property - inherits from parentSiteswap

Can still have class validator based on sequence property

Can use ealier defined properties in later prop definitions
:::

ss423

## Defining methods

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: "1|2-7"
method(print, Siteswap) <- function(x, ...) {
  if (x@valid) {
    cli::cli_bullets(c(
      "v" = "'{x@sequence}' is valid siteswap",
      "i" = "It uses {x@n_props} props"
    ))
  } else {
    cli::cli_bullets(c(
      "x" = "'{x@sequence}' is not a valid juggling pattern",
    ))
  }
}
```

:::{.notes}
print is a generic defined in base R
:::

. . .

```{r}
ss423
```


## Registering generics

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| code-line-numbers: "1-13|4-9"
timeline <- new_generic(
  "timeline",
  "siteswap",
  function(
    siteswap,
    n_cycles = 3,
    title = TRUE,
    subtitle = TRUE,
    ...
  ) {
    S7_dispatch()
  }
)
```

:::{.notes}
Methods signature matches generic (can have additional arguments)
:::

## Method compatibility

```{r}
#| eval: false
method(timeline, vanillaSiteswap) <- function(
  siteswap,
  n_cycles = 3,
  title = TRUE,
  subtitle = TRUE
) {
  # ggplot2 code for vanillaSiteswap timeline
}
```

## Method compatibility

```{r}
#| eval: false
method(timeline, synchronousSiteswap) <- function(
  siteswap,
  n_cycles = 3,
  title = TRUE,
  subtitle = TRUE
) {
  # ggplot2 code for synchronousSiteswap timeline
}
```

```
Imports: S7
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
#' @import S7
NULL
```

## Package name in all classes

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| code-line-numbers: "1,6"
Siteswap <- new_class(
  "Siteswap",
  properties = list(
    ...
  )
  package = "jugglr"
)
```


:::{.notes}
Unlike S3/S4, S7 method dispatch is not wired through NAMESPACE — it registers at load time. Without this, methods silently don't dispatch.

zzz.R because it loads last (S7_on_build needs to be called after methods have been registered)

The way this is done is changed in the S7 devel version
:::

## What to document and export

roxygen2 8.0.0 provides [first-class support for S7](https://roxygen2.r-lib.org/articles/rd-S7.html).

. . .

:::{.center-h .larger200}
**[&#10003; Generics]{.pink}**
::: 

. . .

:::{.center-h .larger200}
**[? Methods]{.blue}**
:::

. . .

:::{.center-h .larger200}
**[&#10003; Classes]{.purple}**
:::

. . .

:::{.center-h .larger150}
`@param`, `@prop`
:::

:::{.notes}
generics - list available methods

methods - only document individually when the method has unique behavior or arguments

classes - document the constructor
:::

## Registering methods: don't `@export`!

in any `.R` file (in S7 v0.2.2):

```{r}
#| eval: false
.onLoad <- function(...) {
  methods_register()
}
```


## Order matters

- Subclass after parent class
- Methods after generic and class

```{r}
#| eval: false
# vanillaSiteswap.R

#' @include siteswap.R # contains `Siteswap`
#' @include generics.R # contains `timeline`
NULL
```

. . .

This generates `DESCRIPTION` field:

```
Collate:
    'generics.R'
    'siteswap.R'
    'vanillaSiteswap.R'
```

:::{.notes}
The order in which files are loaded matters

Use @include

Alphabetical unless told otherwise with `Collate`
:::

## Siteswap variations

- vanilla: **423**
- synchronous: **(4,4)(4x,4x)**
- multiplex: **[54]24**
- synchronous multiplex: **[(2,6x)([6x4x],2x)]**
- passing: **<3p|3p>** or **<4.5 3 3 | 3 4 3.5>**

:::{.notes}
Varies both in notation and in assumptions about how/when the props are thrown amd caught
:::
